description: External sign-in for CodeLogic.WebLogic: Steam OpenID 2.0 and OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect (authorization code + PKCE, nonce, issuer and audience checks, in-house JWT/JWKS validation) with Google, Microsoft, GitHub and Discord presets.
releaseNotes: # Changelog ## 4.9.9-preview (2026-10-27) ### Added - **Account changes are audited.** `WebAccountAuditRecorder` writes these to the audit log: - registration, password change and reset; - e-mail change; - two-factor on/off, recovery codes regenerated or used; - external logins linked or unlinked; - API keys created or revoked; - lockouts. Changes made during a request carry the request (IP hash, path, trace id); others carry only the user. Before, only sign-in/out, passkeys, re-authentication and session revokes were audited, so apps kept their own logs for the rest. `AddHttpContextAccessor` is now registered. - **New events:** - `EmailChangedEvent`, raised after a confirmed address change, in addition to `EmailConfirmedEvent`; - `RecoveryCodesRegeneratedEvent`, which is not raised for the first codes created when two-factor is turned on; - `ExternalLoginChangedEvent`. - **Unlinking external logins:** - `WebExternalLoginFlow.UnlinkAsync(user, provider)` fails with `weblogic.auth.external_login_not_found` when there is no link; - `IWebUserExternalLoginStore.RemoveExternalLoginAsync` is implemented by the in-memory and MySQL stores. It is a default interface method, so existing custom stores still compile; they throw `NotSupportedException` until they implement it; - `LinkAsync` now raises `ExternalLoginChangedEvent`. - **`` accepts base64 raster `data:` images** (png, jpeg, gif, webp), for example a two-factor QR code from `WebTwoFactorEnrollment.QrCodeDataUri`. SVG data, other `data:` URLs and `data:` in every other URL attribute stay blocked. A new encoding context, `TemplateEncodingContext.ImageUrlAttribute`, handles this. ### Fixed - **Partial navigation between layouts.** - **Before:** when a theme did not set `data-wl-layout` on its shells, a link to a page with another layout swapped that page's shell content into the current layout. - **Now:** WebLogic writes the document's outermost template into `wl-config` (`layout`), and the client loads the page in full when it differs. A `data-wl-layout` set by the theme still wins. - **API:** `ITemplateScriptProvider.GetScriptTags(httpContext, nonce, layout)` (default method) and `TemplateRenderContext.DocumentTemplatePath`. - **Signing the same user in again kept dropping "remember me".** `SignInAsync` took `bool persistent` (default `false`), so signing the same user in again turned a persistent session into a browser session. It now takes `bool? persistent` (default `null`): null keeps the current choice for the same user and means "not persistent" for anyone else. Callers passing `true`/`false` are unchanged; code compiled against the old signature must be rebuilt. ### Docs - `client.md`: requests (`wl.http.post` sends JSON; forms and uploads use `request(url, { method, form })`; errors throw `HttpError`) and partial navigation across layouts. - `templates.md`: `` data images. The blocked-URL replacement is `about:blank#blocked`, not `#`. - `security-pipeline.md`: audit categories. - `external-logins.md`: linking and unlinking. - `authentication.md`: `persistent: null`. ## 4.9.8-preview (2026-10-27) ### Fixed - **Form binding matched posted names case-sensitively.** A field named after the property (`Image`, `Email`) did not bind from a client posting `image` or `email`: the field stayed empty, so a `[Required]` field failed and an optional one was silently ignored. Posted names now match case-insensitively, in `BindAsync`, remote field validation, wizard steps and repeater items (file fields already did). If a name is posted twice in different case, the values are merged in posted order and a single-value field takes the first, instead of the post failing. The internal `__wl_*` and CSRF fields are recognised in any case too. ### Changed - A form model whose fields differ only in case (`Name` and `name`) is refused when it is registered (`InvalidOperationException`), because those fields could no longer be told apart. ## 4.9.7-preview (2026-10-27) ### Added - `WebHtmlSanitizer`: opt-in `style` declarations and embed iframes, for rich text that resizes images or embeds videos. - `WebHtmlSanitizerOptions.AllowedStyleProperties`: property name → value check. The attribute is rebuilt from the allowed declarations only. Values with comments, escapes, quotes, `url()` or any function other than `rgb()`/`rgba()`/`hsl()`/`hsla()` are refused before the check, as are unknown properties; `!important` is stripped. - `WebCssValues`: `Length`, `Percentage`, `Color`, `OneOf(...)`, `Any(...)` value checks. - `WebHtmlSanitizerOptions.AllowedFrameSources` (`WebFrameSource(host, pathPrefix)`): https only, exact host, default port, no user info. A kept iframe is rebuilt with `src`, `width`, `height`, `title`, `loading` and the global attributes, plus `FrameSandbox`, `FrameAllow`, `allowfullscreen` and `referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"`; its fallback content is dropped. - Defaults are unchanged: no `style` attributes, no iframes. Add the frame hosts to the CSP (`security.headers.frameSources`) as well. ## 4.9.6-preview (2026-10-27) ### Security - New-device e-mails no longer carry the raw `User-Agent` header. When the browser was not recognised, the header (chosen by the client) went into the mail as the `device` value, and a CL.Mail HTML template using it could be injected into. Unrecognised browsers are now named "an unknown browser". ### Added - `WebSignInResult.Error`: when `CompletePasswordChangeAsync` refuses the new password, the result keeps the token and carries the password policy's message ("Use at least 10 characters.", "The password must not contain your user name or e-mail."), so the page can say why. ### Changed - `UseUserStore()` and the other `Use…()` registrations add `T` as a singleton of its own type and resolve the contract to that same instance. Apps can inject their store by type (for app-specific methods) without casting `IWebUserStore`, and a class registered for several contracts is one instance. ## 4.9.5-preview (2026-10-26) ### Added - Step-up with alternatives: `RequireRecentSignInAnyOf(maxAge, ["pwd", "otp"], ["passkey"])` on routes, groups and policies accepts any one complete set of methods. `RecentSignInRequirement.Alternatives` replaces `Methods`, and `WebRouteSettings.RecentSignInAlternatives` replaces `RecentSignInMethods`. - `WebUserAgent`: browser and system family of a user agent ("Chrome on Windows"), and `WebSessionInfo.Device`. - `Realtime.SessionCheckSeconds` (30) and `SessionEndedEvent`. ### Fixed - A revoked session kept its realtime connection. Signing a device out, the per-user session cap and password-reset sign-outs ended the session, but its SSE/WebSocket stream stayed open for up to `MaxConnectionMinutes` (60) and kept receiving that user's messages. Connections now record their session and close when it ends: at once on the same node, and within `SessionCheckSeconds` on others. - New-device e-mails compared the exact user-agent string, so every browser update was mailed as a new sign-in. They now compare browser and system family and name the device ("Chrome on Windows"). ### Changed - CodeLogic.WebLogic.MySql uses only CL.MySQL2's typed API (now CodeLogic.MySQL2 4.9.101): the add-on contains no SQL text. Rate limits refill and charge a bucket with one atomic update-and-read, a sign-in failure is one upsert, a fresh one-time key is one round trip, and recovery code sets are replaced in one transaction. ## 4.9.4-preview (2026-10-26) ### Added - Passkeys (WebAuthn), verified in-house: CBOR, COSE keys (ES256/384/512, RS256, PS256), authenticator data, signatures, and the `none`, `packed` and `fido-u2f` attestation formats. - **Three uses:** passwordless sign-in (`request.Auth.PasskeySignInAsync`, multi-factor, so no TOTP step), the second factor after a password (`CompleteTwoFactorWithPasskeyAsync`), and step-up (`ReauthenticateWithPasskeyAsync`). - **Registration and management:** `BeginPasskeyRegistrationAsync` and `CompletePasskeyRegistrationAsync`, plus list, rename and delete. Users are e-mailed when a passkey is added or removed. - **Safety:** ceremony state is sealed and each challenge is single-use (works across nodes). Origin, RP id, user presence and verification, backup flags and the user handle are checked. A signature counter that goes backwards refuses the sign-in (`PasskeyCloneSuspectedEvent`). - **Lockout:** the password lockout neither blocks passkeys nor counts passkey failures, because credential ids are not secret. Failures are throttled instead. - **Wiring:** `IWebPasskeyStore` (`web.UsePasskeyStore()`, an in-memory store with `UseInMemoryAccounts`) and `Auth.Passkeys` configuration (RP id, origins, timeout, attestation, second factor without PIN, maximum per user). - Client: `WebLogic.passkeys` (`signIn`, `register`, `verify`, passkey autofill) and declarative `data-wl-passkey` buttons. - Testing: `WebTestAuthenticator`, a software authenticator for testing passkey endpoints. The suite also runs the client against a headless-Chrome virtual authenticator. - CodeLogic.WebLogic.MySql: `wl_passkeys` (`WebMySqlStores.Passkeys`, included in `All`), with an atomic counter update. - Starter sample: passkey sign-in with autofill, passkey as the second factor, and a Passkeys card on the account page. ### Fixed - A suspended user's reason and end date were lost on the way back from password, magic-link and external sign-in (`WebSignInResult.Suspension` was null), so the suspension page could not show them. ## 4.9.3-preview (2026-10-26) ### Added - App-managed IP rules and blocklists: `IWebIpRuleProvider` (`web.AddIpRuleProvider()`) returns `WebIpRule`s (deny, allow or exempt; network or country; expiry; reason) merged with `Security.IpRules`, and `IWebReputationListProvider` returns DNSBL zones that replace the CL.NetUtils services. Cached for `IpRules.ProviderCacheSeconds` (60); `IWebSecurityRulesInvalidator.Invalidate()` applies edits at once; a failing provider keeps the last good rules. Exempt addresses skip the allow-list, country rules and the DNSBL check. - `WebSecurityRejectedEvent.RuleId` (and `WebSecurityDecision.RuleId`): the matched rule (`ban-42`, `config.deny[0]`, `dnsbl:{zone}`) for hit counters, never the client address. - DataProtection key ring in CL.Storage: `AddDataProtection().PersistKeysToCodeLogicStorage(connectionId, path)` (one file per key, never overwritten, storage errors fail instead of minting new keys), and `ProtectKeysWithSecret(variable, previousVariables...)` to encrypt keys at rest with AES-256-GCM from an environment secret, with rotation. Cluster checks accept the storage repository and warn about a plain folder. - Plugin assets: `b.MapAssets(assembly, "assets/", name)` serves embedded files at `/_weblogic/plugins/{name}/...` (ETag, extension allowlist, path checks, removed with the plugin); `{asset:name:path}` gives a fingerprinted URL, and a theme file at `assets/plugins/{name}/{path}` overrides it. - Group layouts: `WithLayout("admin/layout")` on routes and groups, used by page templates that declare no `{layout:...}` (`TemplateRenderRequest.DefaultLayout`). - Account suspension: `WebUser.SuspendedUntil` and `SuspensionReason`. Sign-in returns `WebSignInStatus.Suspended` with `WebSignInResult.Suspension` (only after the credentials were proven); sessions end at the next stamp check and API keys stop working. `WebResult.AccountSuspended(suspension)` renders the theme's `errors/suspended` page (plain fallback, ProblemDetails for API clients). Both samples handle it; MiniBlog adds two user columns. - Git theme credentials in `ThemeConfig`: `GitTokenEnvironmentVariable` (or the secret `GitToken`), `GitUserName`, `GitSshKeyPath` and `GitSshPassphraseEnvironmentVariable`. - `WebThemeChecker.Check(folder)` lists templates that do not parse (file, line, column), and `tools/CL.WebLogic.ThemeCheck` runs it from the command line. CI checks both sample themes. - New package **CodeLogic.WebLogic.MySql**: production stores on CL.MySQL2 for every contract (users with lockout, e-mail and external logins; sessions with device listing; API keys; recovery codes; one-time keys; login throttle; rate limits; audit; widget settings; dashboards) and the DataProtection key ring. `web.UseMySqlStores(connectionId, o => o.Stores = ...)`, `AddDataProtection().PersistKeysToMySql(connectionId)`. Schema sync at startup, a background sweep, and cross-node guarantees (single-use consumes, atomic lockout, exact rate-limit capacity, versioned dashboards). Tested against MySQL 8.4 in CI. - New package **CodeLogic.WebLogic.ExternalLogins**: `AddSteamLogin()` (moved from the starter sample), `AddOAuthLogin(options)` for any OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect provider (authorization code + PKCE S256, nonce, discovery with issuer check, in-house JWT validation for RS/PS/ES 256-512 with JWKS rotation, `iss`/`aud`/`azp`/`exp`/`nbf`/`iat`, RFC 9207 `iss` check), and presets `AddGoogleLogin`, `AddMicrosoftLogin`, `AddGitHubLogin`, `AddDiscordLogin`. - `WebExternalChallenge.CodeVerifier` and `CodeChallenge`: `WebExternalLoginFlow` now creates a PKCE verifier per sign-in and keeps it in its protected cookie. ### Changed - Releases are manual only: the `promote.yml` workflow that merged `main` into `release` after green tests is removed. Publish with `git push origin main:prerelease` or `main:release`. - `IpRulesStage` and `ReputationStage` take a `WebSecurityRules` (resolved from DI). - MiniBlog uses `CodeLogic.WebLogic.MySql` for its stores and key ring (encrypted when `MINIBLOG_KEYRING_SECRET` is set); its own user, session, recovery-code, widget and dashboard stores are gone. The starter sample uses `CodeLogic.WebLogic.ExternalLogins` (Steam, plus Google, Microsoft, GitHub and Discord when `STARTER_{PROVIDER}_CLIENT_ID` and `_CLIENT_SECRET` are set). ## 4.9.2-preview (2026-10-26) ### Added - `request.Auth.SignInExternalAsync(user, provider)`: sign-in for users an external provider vouched for. Applies the account rules (disabled, locked, other tenant) and asks users with two-factor authentication for their code, like a password sign-in. Recorded as `ext:{provider}`. - Per-area sign-in pages: `WithLoginPath(path)` and `WithAccessDeniedPath(path)` on routes and groups (inherited; local paths only). Signed-in users without access are sent to the denied page instead of a 403 (pages only). - Step-up: `RequireRecentSignIn(maxAge, methods...)` on routes and groups, and on policies (`RecentSignInRequirement`). Failing it asks the user to sign in again (`reauth=1` redirect, or `401` with `error="reauthentication_required"` for APIs) instead of forbidding. `request.Auth.ReauthenticateAsync(password, code)` proves the user again; sessions and `WebIdentity` record `AuthenticatedAt`. - "Remember me": a `persistent` flag on every sign-in method, carried through the second factor and a required password change. `Session.PersistentIdleTimeoutDays` (30) and `Session.PersistentAbsoluteTimeoutDays` (90). - Sessions as devices: records keep the user agent, authentication time and "remember me"; the optional store capability `IWebSessionListStore` enables `request.Auth.ListSessionsAsync()`, `RevokeSessionAsync(idHash)`, `Session.MaxPerUser` and new-device e-mails (`Auth.Notifications.NotifyNewDevice`, notification kind `NewDeviceSignIn`). The in-memory store and both samples implement it; the starter's account page lists signed-in devices. - CSP: `MediaSources`, `WorkerSources`, `ManifestSources`, `FormActions` and `CspReportTo` (`Reporting-Endpoints` + `report-to`). Per-route additions with `WithCsp(c => c.AddFrameSource(...))` (validated: hosts, schemes and `'self'` only), built once per route. - The explorer shows a route's login path, step-up requirement and CSP additions. - `CodeLogic.WebLogic.Testing` ships a package readme (usage example and helper overview); the `CodeLogic.WebLogic` readme gains a quick start and links to the docs. ### Changed (breaking) - `request.Auth.PasswordSignInAsync`, `SignInAsync` and `SignInWithMagicLinkAsync` take `persistent` before the cancellation token: callers passing the token positionally must name it (`cancellationToken: ct`). The matching `WebAuthService` methods changed the same way. - Sessions signed in without "remember me" now use a browser-session cookie (no `Expires`); before, every session cookie lasted until the absolute timeout. - Magic-link sign-in refuses users of another tenant, like password sign-in. - `WebAuthService` takes a `WebSessionDevices` (resolved from DI). ### Fixed - CI: golden template snapshots are found under deterministic (`/_/`) build paths, the Markdown pathological-input test compares scaling instead of wall-clock time, and parallel Docker builds lock the shared NuGet cache. ## 4.9.1-preview (2026-10-25) First preview of the rebuild on nuget.org. ### Added - New repository: CL.WebLogic rebuilt from the ground up on CodeLogic 4.9 and published as `CodeLogic.WebLogic`. Breaking with the 0.x line — see `docs/guides/migrating.md`. - `WebLogicLibrary` implements `IConfigReloadable`: `weblogic` config changes are applied live through `WebLogicConfigHolder`; restart-only fields are flagged (`WebLogicRestartRequiredEvent`, Degraded health) instead of failing the change. - `IWebLogicContext` decouples toolkit services from the static CodeLogic runtime. - `CodeLogic.WebLogic.Testing` package with `FakeWebLogicContext` and `RecordingLogger`. - Hosting: `AddCodeLogicWebLogic()` / `UseCodeLogicWebLogic()` / `MapCodeLogicWebLogic()`. Every WebLogic route is a real ASP.NET endpoint (templates and constraints such as `{id:int}`, 405 with `Allow`, HEAD for GET routes, per-endpoint CORS) and mixes freely with minimal APIs. - Routing: `IWebContributor.ContributeAsync(WebContributionBuilder, ct)` with `MapPage`, `MapApi`, `MapFragment`, `MapSse`, `MapFallback` and nested `MapGroup` prefixes whose options (anonymous access, groups, permissions, policies, CORS, rate limit, body limit, middleware) are inherited. Routes are **secure by default**; anonymous routes are listed at registration. - Contributions are all-or-nothing and removable: `WebContributionHandle`, `OnRemove` cleanups, ambiguity detection, a single fallback. CodeLogic plugins implementing `IWebContributor` are registered on load and removed on unload. - Results: `Html`, `Text`, `Json` (per-contributor serializer options), `Bytes`, local-only `Redirect` / explicit `ExternalRedirect`, `File` (ranges, ETag), `Problem` / `ValidationProblem` (RFC 7807), `NoContent`, `Status`, `Commands` (allowlisted client commands), `Sse`, `FromAspNet`. - `WebRequestContext` per request (no static accessor) with bounded body readers (413 above the route limit), typed route values and cancellation on client disconnect. - Exception boundary: correlation ids, safe 500 pages (details only in Development), ProblemDetails for APIs, bodies for empty 4xx/5xx responses, client disconnects logged at Debug. - Health probes `/_weblogic/health/live` and `/_weblogic/health/ready`. - Theme assets served only from the theme's `assets` folder with path containment, dotfile and symlink refusal, an extension allowlist, ETag / Last-Modified and immutable caching for `?v=` URLs. - Templates: the AST template engine, ported and split into small types. Two engines share one set of execution semantics (`TemplateOps`): `ClosureTemplateCompiler` (default; compiles a template once into delegates) and `TemplateInterpreter` (the reference AST walk), selected with `Theme.TemplateEngine`. The legacy regex engine is gone. - Context-aware output encoding: the parser infers whether each value lands in element text, a quoted attribute, a URL attribute (scheme allowlist: http, https, mailto, tel), a `style` attribute, `
